privacy.title: Software License & Privacy Policy
privacy.sub: This page covers the DeskBud desktop-pet software license (EULA), privacy statement and copyright notice. Please read carefully before use.
privacy.desc: DeskBud desktop-pet software license (EULA), privacy statement and copyright notice
privacy.sectionHint: No personal data is collected or uploaded
privacy.offline: With no network connection, all core features work fully and normally — pet interactions, keeping multiple pets, menu settings, local quotes — with no network restrictions.
privacy.net: The network is used only for the following four purposes, with no extra background requests or data reporting:
privacy.net2: Loading pages of the official website (https://deskbud.xyz/);
privacy.core: The software never collects or uploads any personal information. All network activity serves features only — nothing beyond usage events and the device identifier is ever collected.
privacy.pay1: Additional pets are premium content: after unlocking, download, installation and activation complete automatically — no manual steps;
privacy.pay2: Premium verification checks device entitlement only; no personally identifiable data is collected or linked;
privacy.pay3: Unlocked pet resources are stored locally and work offline forever.
privacy.third: Payments are handled by third-party platforms (WeChat Pay, Alipay, etc.). The software never obtains or stores sensitive data such as payment accounts, passwords or real-name transaction details.
privacy.sec1: All network traffic uses HTTPS encryption;
privacy.sec2: Pet resources, settings and downloaded content stay on your device — no cloud sync, no background uploads;
privacy.sec3: No analytics tracking, no privacy data collection or reporting.
privacy.tip: 💡 All data stays on your device. Your little companion is just there for you — no gossiping.
